Pauses touchscreen input until the selected volume key is pressed.

While touch is paused, TouchPause receives touchscreen and stylus motion, including positions and timing, and all hardware-key events. It processes these events only on your device, uses key events only to detect the selected volume key, forwards unrelated keys, and immediately discards every event. It never reads screen content, stores input events, or shares them.

To pause touch without root, TouchPause uses Android’s Accessibility service to access raw touchscreen and stylus motion, including touch and stylus positions and timing, and all hardware-key events while touch is paused. It withholds touchscreen and stylus motion from other apps, processes all events only on your device, uses key events only to detect the selected volume key, and forwards all unrelated keys. It immediately discards every event. It never reads screen content, stores these events, or shares them with anyone.
Root and root-manager approval are required on Android 13 or older, for the Power release key, or when rootless capture is unavailable. TouchPause requests root only when needed.

No data transmission or retention, no ads, and no network access. Tap for details.

TouchPause runs entirely on your device. It never reads screen content or stores, sends, or shares touch, stylus, or key events. Root mode temporarily reads input devices only while a user-started block is active.\n\nTouchPause is GPL-3.0-or-later. Its bundled blockevent helper is Apache-2.0.
